name: Credential Access (Simulated)
description: Validate that credential-access TACTICS would be detected, using SYNTHETIC telemetry only. No credential material is accessed, dumped, or brute-forced; each step is a record plus generated fixture events used to confirm the defense produces the expected signal.

steps.name: OS Credential Dumping (simulated signal)
steps.description: Synthetic telemetry representing access to a credential store, used to test whether the EDR/SIEM would alert. Nothing is read.

steps.name: Unsecured Credentials (simulated signal)
steps.description: Synthetic file-access telemetry against locations where credentials are commonly left, to validate detection. No files are read.

steps.name: Brute Force (simulated signal)
steps.description: Synthetic authentication-failure telemetry to validate lockout/anomaly detection. No authentication is attempted.
